name: Survey tile in Aries
blurb: A 0.3 degree patch 2.6 degrees north of the ecliptic in Aries, imaged by SPHEREx 14 times in 5 visits over 34 hours. Picked automatically by the survey because it was imaged often enough to follow a moving object.
summary_plain: 30 SPHEREx images of this patch taken over 34 hours starting 2026-01-16, at wavelengths from 0.75 to 4.26 µm. The pipeline found 1 moving object.
